title: Effective descent and sectionwise gluing of a prescribed etale framed line module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Put $\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}(u:U\to X)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$. Modules on a site and their morphisms mean sheaves of modules and all module morphisms [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $G$ be an $\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}$-module and let $(u_a:U_a\to X)_{a\in I}$ be an arbitrary set-indexed jointly surjective etale family. Suppose given frames $t_a:\mathcal O_{U_a,\mathrm{et}}\simeq G|_{(U_a)_{\mathrm{et}}}$ and units $g_{ab}\in\Gamma(R_{ab},\mathcal O_{R_{ab}})^\times$, where $R_{ab}=U_a\times_XU_b$. Assume $t_b=t_a m_{g_{ab}}$ on $(R_{ab})_{\mathrm{et}}$, where $m_g$ is multiplication by the pullbacks of $g$; assume also $p_{ab}^*g_{ab}\,p_{bc}^*g_{bc}=p_{ac}^*g_{ac}$ on triple products and $\Delta_a^*g_{aa}=1$. There exist an ordinary invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $L$ [def-sc-invertible-module] and isomorphisms $\lambda_a:u_a^*L\simeq\mathcal O_{U_a}$ [def-pc-module-pullback] with $\lambda_a=m_{g_{ab}}\lambda_b$ on $R_{ab}$, after canonical pullback identifications. For $A_X(L)(u)=\Gamma(U,u^*L)$ [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], the local isomorphisms $e_a=t_a A_{U_a}(\lambda_a):A_X(L)|_{(U_a)_{\mathrm{et}}}\simeq G|_{(U_a)_{\mathrm{et}}}$, with their domains identified by tensor composition, agree on overlaps and determine a unique global module-sheaf isomorphism $e:A_X(L)\simeq G$. Explicitly, for each object $W\to X$ and $s\in A_X(L)(W)$, $e_W(s)$ is the unique section of $G(W)$ restricting to $e_a(s|_{W_a})$ on $W_a=W\times_XU_a$. Its inverse is characterized by the analogous rule for the $e_a^{-1}$. These formulas commute with every restriction, addition and scalar multiplication. The assertion holds without quasi-compactness or separatedness assumptions on $X$.

proof.text: Put $M_a=\mathcal O_{U_a}$. Identify its two pullbacks to $R_{ab}$ with $\mathcal O_{R_{ab}}$ by the tensor-unit identifications, and define $\varphi_{ab}:p_a^*M_a\to p_b^*M_b$ to be multiplication by $g_{ab}^{-1}$. This is an isomorphism with inverse multiplication by $g_{ab}$. On triple products, $\varphi_{bc}\varphi_{ab}=m_{g_{bc}^{-1}g_{ab}^{-1}}=m_{g_{ac}^{-1}}=\varphi_{ac}$ by the given cocycle. Its pullback along $\Delta_a$ is the identity by the given normalization. Thus the trivial invertible modules, which are Zariski free of rank one, form a descent datum with the arrow direction used in [lem-pc-fpqc-descent].

proof.text: The given family covers the final object $X\to X$ in $X_{\mathrm{et}}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-finer-than-etale] it is an fpqc covering, for the same arbitrary set of indices. Apply clause (3) of [lem-pc-fpqc-descent] to the datum of Step 1. It gives an ordinary invertible $L$ and isomorphisms $\lambda_a:u_a^*L\simeq M_a$ identifying the canonical descent datum of $L$ with $\varphi_{ab}$. Explicitly, on $R_{ab}$ this compatibility is $\lambda_b=\varphi_{ab}\lambda_a=m_{g_{ab}^{-1}}\lambda_a$, or equivalently $\lambda_a=m_{g_{ab}}\lambda_b$, as required. Both cited results hold for general schemes, with no quasi-compactness or separatedness hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), proof: descent datum, effectivity and final gluing; small etale case. Tag 023T (proposition-fpqc-descent-quasi-coherent) and Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), rank one.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-etale-line-sections-normalized-comparisons] to $L$, to each $u_a$, and to the overlap projections. Its functor, unit and composition comparisons make $e_a=t_a\epsilon_{U_a}A_{U_a}(\lambda_a)\beta_{u_a,L}$ a local module-sheaf isomorphism, where $\epsilon$ identifies the associated structure module with the structure sheaf. These are the implicit identifications in the statement. For any etale object $V\to R_{ab}$ and any section $z$ of the restricted $A_X(L)$, the component formula in that node sends multiplication by $g_{ab}$ to multiplication by its pullback to $V$: pullback is linear and the tensor-unit formula is $a\otimes b\mapsto a\,v^\sharp(b)$. Thus, after its coherent domain identifications, $e_a(z)=t_a(m_{g_{ab}}A(\lambda_b)(z))=t_b(A(\lambda_b)(z))=e_b(z)$. This proves equality of the local maps on the whole overlap site, rather than just on its final object.

source.place: Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), proof: descent datum, effectivity and final gluing; small etale case. Tag 023T (proposition-fpqc-descent-quasi-coherent) and Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), rank one.

proof.text: Fix $W\to X$ and put $W_a=W\times_XU_a$. This is a covering family of $W$ in the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For $s\in A_X(L)(W)$, Step 3 says that $e_a(s|_{W_a})$ and $e_b(s|_{W_b})$ have equal restrictions to $W_a\times_WW_b$. Since the underlying abelian sheaf of $G$ satisfies the equalizer condition [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], these sections have a unique amalgamation; define it to be $e_W(s)$. For an arrow $h:W'\to W$, both $e_W(s)|_{W'}$ and $e_{W'}(s|_{W'})$ restrict on $W'_a$ to $e_a(s|_{W'_a})$, by naturality of $e_a$, so they are equal. For $s,s'$ the restrictions of $e_W(s+s')$ and $e_W(s)+e_W(s')$ agree by additivity of each $e_a$, so they are equal. For $r\in\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}(W)$ the same calculation gives $e_W(rs)=r e_W(s)$, using the semilinear restrictions in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Hence $e$ is a module-sheaf morphism. On an object $W\to U_a$, its restrictions over the cover $W\times_XU_b\to W$ agree with those of $e_a$, by Step 3; uniqueness of amalgamation therefore shows that its restriction to $(U_a)_{\mathrm{et}}$ is exactly $e_a$.

source.place: Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), proof: descent datum, effectivity and final gluing; small etale case. Tag 023T (proposition-fpqc-descent-quasi-coherent) and Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), rank one.

proof.text: The equality $e_a=e_b$ on overlaps gives $e_a^{-1}=e_b^{-1}$ there. The source $A_X(L)$ is a module sheaf by [lem-trf-etale-line-sections-normalized-comparisons]. For $y\in G(W)$ glue the compatible family $e_a^{-1}(y|_{W_a})$ in this sheaf, using the same equalizer condition [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], to define $d_W(y)$. As in Step 4, uniqueness proves that $d$ commutes with restrictions, addition and scalars. The composites $d_We_W$ and $e_Wd_W$ restrict on each $W_a$ to identities, so the injective part of the equalizer condition makes them identities on $W$. Thus $d=e^{-1}$. Any morphism with the prescribed local maps has, at every $s$, the same local values as $e_W(s)$, so uniqueness of amalgamation makes it equal to $e$. This proves both explicit formulas and all their asserted compatibilities.

e : (@Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf _ L (@Modules.IsInvertible.isQuasicoherent _ L hL)) ≅ (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Modules.smallEtaleModuleRing X)).obj G, (∀ (W : X.Etale) (r : Γ(W.left, ⊤)) (s : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback W.hom).obj L, ⊤)), e.hom.hom.app (op W) ((((Modules.tensorPullback W.hom).obj L).smul r).hom s) = r • (@id (G.val.obj (op W)) (e.hom.hom.app (op W) s))) ∧ (∀ (a : I) (W : X.Etale) (f : W ⟶ U a) (s : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback W.hom).obj L, ⊤)), e.hom.hom.app (op W) s = (t a).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk f)) ((trfPulledFrame L (lam a) f).hom.app ⊤ s)) ∧ (∀ (a b : I) (W : X.Etale) (f : W ⟶ U a) (h : W ⟶ U b) (s : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback W.hom).obj L, ⊤)), (t a).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk f)) ((trfPulledFrame L (lam a) f).hom.app ⊤ s) = (t b).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk h)) ((trfPulledFrame L (lam b) h).hom.app ⊤ s)) ∧ (∀ (W : X.Etale) (s : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback W.hom).obj L, ⊤)) (y : G.val.obj (op W)), (∀ a : I, G.val.map (Limits.prod.fst (X := W) (Y := U a)).op y = (t a).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (Limits.prod.snd (X := W) (Y := U a)))) ((trfPulledFrame L (lam a) (Limits.prod.snd (X := W) (Y := U a))).hom.app ⊤ (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction L (Limits.prod.fst (X := W) (Y := U a)) s))) ↔ y = e.hom.hom.app (op W) s) ∧ (∀ (W : X.Etale) (y : G.val.obj (op W)) (s : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback W.hom).obj L, ⊤)), (∀ a : I, Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction L (Limits.prod.fst (X := W) (Y := U a)) s = (trfPulledFrame L (lam a) (Limits.prod.snd (X := W) (Y := U a))).inv.app ⊤ ((t a).inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (Limits.prod.snd (X := W) (Y := U a)))) (G.val.map (Limits.prod.fst (X := W) (Y := U a)).op y))) ↔ s = e.inv.hom.app (op W) y)
lean.note: Frames are on the equivalent localized small-etale sites. Products in X.Etale represent fibre products over X. The global isomorphism is stated as an additive-sheaf isomorphism with explicit scalar linearity, exactly a module-sheaf isomorphism; its local and both unique-amalgamation formulas are explicit. Canonical comparisons use the recorded tensor pullback, its normalized composition, and the adjoint tensor-unit map. No equivalence theorem is assumed.
